correctness.rationale: The operation is a well-defined quandle; every right translation equals T_sigma because sigma fixes its first coordinate. For n>=3 transpositions occur and generate the full faithful S_n diagonal action. D is definable by identity right translations, and restriction of any automorphism to D uniquely determines an S_n factor. Pointwise D-fixed maps preserve each permutation label and centralize S_n; centralizers induce the full S_m on m fixed points, with nontrivial center only for m=2. Independent conjugacy-invariant swaps exhaust the kernel, are genuine automorphisms, and commute with S_n. Partition count p(n-2)-p(n-3) is exact. Every claimed finite check has a standalone reproducible program.

value.rationale: The fixed-point subquandle is a natural factorial-size universal host for n-element quandles, so its full symmetry group is an object-specific invariant of direct use. The result gives an explicit infinite classification, recovers the inner S_n action, and explains structurally when extra independent outer automorphisms occur. This is not a routine small-table recomputation: the elementary abelian factor has partition-number rank growing with n, invisible from known orbit or inner-group formulas.
